name: io.github.hunyu-feng/dsh-vision
title: DSH Vision (Volcano Ark)
description: Analyze images (local files or URLs) with Doubao vision models on Volcano Ark, with model fallback.

environmentVariables.name: VOLCANO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Volcano Ark API key used to call the vision models.

environmentVariables.name: VISION_MODELS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated model ids tried in order, e.g. doubao-seed-2-0-pro-260215,doubao-1-5-vision-pro-32k-250115.

environmentVariables.name: ARK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Ark OpenAI-compatible base URL (default https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3).
